name: PDFScribe
description: Transcribes PDFs into faithful, structured Markdown using native Claude vision, with checksum-validated caching, page splitting, and optional RAG ingest

capabilities: Native vision transcription of scanned and born-digital PDFs (no external API)
Batched multi-page reading for documents of any length
Structured notation for handwriting, signatures, stamps, seals, and checkboxes
Explicit uncertainty marking ({?} and {illegible}) instead of silent guessing
Table extraction to HTML with merged-cell and cross-page continuation support
Substantive figure and photograph description for inspection reports
Strikethrough/underline preservation for governing document amendments
Document-type profiles (minutes, financials, governing docs, inspections, proposals)
Checksum-validated caching next to source (Google Drive synced folders included)
RAG ingest over plain HTTP to the RAG API
Static site generation with page-image galleries

trigger.description: Called by other agents or users when PDF content extraction is needed

toolchain.note: Transcription is performed by the agent's own vision via the Read tool. No transcription API key is required. The pdfscribe MCP server and pdfscribe_cli.py were retired in v3.0.

rag_integration.notes: Ingest is the only operation with an external dependency. If RAG_API_KEY is unset, complete and cache the transcription and report the ingest as skipped — never report success for a step that did not run.
